description: A Perl script for flashing firmware on D-Link DSL-502T devices, including firmware verification, MTD configuration, and device reboot procedures.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with ADAM2 bootloader, including environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to the FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends the REBOOT command to the FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device via FTP command.
